scope: A versioned Pkl carrier owns an Apple project payload; project.pkl is a payload-free active composition entrypoint when discovery requires it.
commands: vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test xcode --artifact app --pkl-path <app>/project-v000_000_001.pkl --xcode-project <app>/<app>.xcodeproj --scheme <scheme> --configuration debug --xcode-destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' --xcode-build-setting CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
toolingBoundary: The first two commands establish composition equivalence; project generation proves source world-state only. The final app-test command requires a source-tested installed Vaporize that contains the Pkl/Xcode app-test bridge.
claims: The versioned carrier names a v0.0.x project payload.
The composition entrypoint contains no target configuration payload.
A generated Xcode project remains distinct from installed-runtime and release evidence.
